content.text: Rescuers were called to the waters at Sutton Park, Sutton Coldfield, just after 18:00 BST on Thursday, but Daniel Drewitt had died before his body was recovered from the water, ambulance crews said.
On Thursday, 16-year-old Daniel Drewitt was discovered in a pool at Sutton Park in Sutton Coldfield.

Colmers School and Sixth Form College staff: Daniel was a young man who brought light and character to our entire school community; he was confident, full of life, a talented sportsman and so deeply loved by staff and fellow pupils alike,
